title: Skill text: master-detail inline editing still says `inlineEdit: true` puts the child grid in the parent form; since #35921 a parent field group must name it
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filing gate: ① a product defect (AI taught wrong) with a named landing. Source: the #35902 slice-2 card thread, found while writing PR #36222 and left out of it because it is form entry and spans three other files.

## What is stale

Since #35921 (#35889), a master-detail child is a tab by default, and it goes into the parent's form or field area only when a parent field group names it (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`). Three skill texts still teach the old rule, that `inlineEdit: true` on the child alone puts the child grid into the parent form:
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, section "Inline Editing".
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md:370`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:48`.

## Why

An AI build that follows these lines writes `inlineEdit: true` and expects line items in the parent's form. On main it gets a tab, so the invoice and quote forms that users fill in have no lines.

## Done when

- The three places teach the current rule (a parent group names the child list; `inlineEdit` controls in-place editing only), each with one minimal example and the "without it, nothing changes" line.
- An eval case: 「新建报价单时在表单里直接录明细」 produces the group pointing at the child list.
- The bytes are paid for by stale text in the same files (ratchet ceilings unchanged). `domain:skills` PR.

Reader: `domain:skills`; epic #35896 neighbour (`Skills-docs` follow-up of #35921).

Dedupe: `inlineEdit 子表 表单 技能`, `inlineEdit master detail skill` (objectstack issues, open) → none; #35902 covers tabs and groups, not form entry.
